bf-1c471c67a9bc9b72de77cc3d.what: A jobs request waiting for HTTP headers ignores caller cancellation and keeps the CLI alive after SIGINT.
bf-1c471c67a9bc9b72de77cc3d.root_cause: packages/cli/src/services/http.service.ts httpLayer.request uses acquireRelease with its default uninterruptible acquisition, masking interruption of the fetch Promise.
bf-1c471c67a9bc9b72de77cc3d.fixed_by: Opt into interruptible acquisition for the scoped native fetch. Cancellation reaches its AbortSignal before response headers arrive while existing response/body finalizers and byte bounds remain intact.

bf-a2da0ca60e9c828fc35b84bd.what: Generated HTTP functions received an empty environment despite successful candidate environment resolution.
bf-a2da0ca60e9c828fc35b84bd.root_cause: packages/cli/src/commands/build-server-invocation.ts invokeHttp omitted env from engine invoke options. packages/cli/src/commands/build-server-invocation.ts:18 now forwards the resolved values.
bf-a2da0ca60e9c828fc35b84bd.fixed_by: Forward env: values into the generated HTTP invocation. The capturing generated-wiring regression failed before this edit and passes after it; both real CLI/HTTP matrices now return the resolved defaults and repaired values.
